sections.title: Overview
sections.content: While being a summonable Unit in the game, Zelban became an important figure during the timeline of the Ten-Winged Tormentor's havoc throughout the region of Lizeria. It is also the very same Zelban who instructed one of the Six Heroes, Atro, in the art of La Veda fencing style.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- The Zelban from Michele's GQ was 35 years old.
- According to the lore, a person who mastered Vedan fencing style is known as Zelban. This title is originally passed down from the master to their best disciple, but it was hinted that people from Grand Gaia continued the tradition even after they moved to Elgaia.
- The current known "Zelban" in Elgaia is Lugina.
